title: Snapshots, the sample tenant, readiness, the scope and permission maps and the Scope page's channel logic

checks.what: Snapshot save reads only ticked scopes and channels, GET only
Snapshot open: untrusted file (size, depth, node count, format, version, fields, status, every path, NaN)
Masking of secret fields in snapshots, against every secret-like field name in the SDK models
Compare: per object, change times ignored, scrubbed on both sides, one row shape
Offline clients (raw and SDK) open no socket; every service builds on the in-memory executor
Writes refused while a snapshot is open (raw, SDK, every method)
Offline tenant cookie and request context: exact ids only, fail closed when gone, robust to neighbour cookies
Sample field names vs SDK 1.11.3 models (21 answers)
Every check and page read on the sample: answers for every SDK-documented endpoint
Sample deterministic and copy-isolated; reserved example domains only
Verdict oracle: 5 roles x 4 licence states for the DLP scope, web/email write kinds and Deploy policy packs
ZPA role read through the SDK's own service
Token decode limits (size, base64, UTF-8, depth, object, list caps) and licence date bounds
Readiness HTML escapes every tenant value; locked browsers see none
Every Scope page key has a Required API access card and readiness mapping
Every write kind maps to a portal permission and a readiness need
Every ZIA permission listed is in the SDK admin_roles docs (two aliases accepted)
Every registry section maps to the Scope page key that runs it
'Marked Zscaler' oracle: choice normalization, prerequisites, blocked alternatives, declarations, partition, pack targets
Beacon watch reads no channel left out of the declaration; unmapped endpoints never read
Endpoint pattern is linear (no ReDoS)

findings.title: Snapshots kept Client Connector OTPs and stored credentials (deviceOtpArray, exitOtp, uninstallOtp, zpaDisableOtp, credJson, tempAuthCode, keyValue, apiCredentials, provisionKey) in the saved file
findings.fix: scrub masks every OTP and stored-credential field name the SDK models use, any value type

findings.title: Another localhost app's malformed cookie made the server ignore the sample/snapshot choice and put the browser back on the live tenant
findings.fix: the offline cookie is read pair by pair (RFC 6265) instead of SimpleCookie, which drops every cookie after one it cannot parse

findings.title: Readiness never found the API client's ZPA role: the SDK hands list_roles' body as a {list: [...]} envelope, so view-only ZPA classes were missed and segment moves judged on the role name alone
findings.fix: _find_by reads the ZPA envelope's list (bounded)

findings.title: Compare with the live tenant keyed and named an object with no id or name by its unscrubbed live JSON, so a secret field's value could appear in the result
findings.fix: both sides are scrubbed before keying and naming; settings rows carry counts like list rows

findings.title: A licence end date too large for a float (or hugely negative) raised OverflowError and crashed the readiness job
findings.fix: the end date is bounded before any arithmetic, as _iso already did

findings.title: The rbac Scope page key had no Required API access card, and refused RBAC checks were counted under zia_extras, zcc, zpa or zidentity, so the RBAC permissions were never listed
findings.fix: rbac added to SCOPE_PERMISSIONS; every RBAC section maps to rbac

findings.title: Sample tenant shapes differed from the API (ZDX camelCase, invented company-info and app-profile fields, Evaluate All Rules under advancedSettings, endpoint/email receivers, file-type classes) and it lacked answers the checks and pages read (14 Cloud App Control types, DLP global options, privacy, cleanup, admin sync, ZDX alerts and inventory, Path analyzer ZIA reads, ZPA roles and profiles)
findings.fix: sample data re-shaped from SDK 1.11.3 models; every SDK-documented read a check or page makes has an answer

findings.title: The offline platform filter ignored device_type (the API's app-profile field), so a per-platform read returned every platform's profiles
findings.fix: answer_get filters on device_type or deviceType

findings.title: A saved snapshot dropped the channel declaration it was saved with (_clean_meta rejected channel_scope.normalize's dicts)
findings.fix: _clean_meta keeps each channel's choice from a normalized declaration

findings.title: Sample writes aliased the caller's payload: changing a posted or updated dict later changed the in-memory tenant
findings.fix: POST and PUT deep-copy the body

findings.title: Copying the channel guard (channel_scope.ScopedClient) recursed until RecursionError (__getattr__ before __init__)
findings.fix: __getattr__ answers AttributeError for _client and dunder names

findings.title: A request could rename a fixed Scope page channel, and that name appeared in the report and page notes
findings.fix: a Scope page channel always carries its canonical name; custom channels keep theirs, bounded

findings.title: open_document accepted the sample's id, so a snapshot could replace the sample tenant in memory (unreachable from the routes today: tenant_profiles validates ids)
findings.fix: a snapshot never takes the id 'sample'

findings.title: The offline id pattern ended in '$', which also accepts a trailing newline
findings.fix: anchored with \A and \Z

findings.title: Traffic flow (data_flow.py) reads only older app-profile names: on an API-shaped profile it shows Endpoint DLP and the SSL certificate as off and drops the comma-separated destination exclusions and custom app bypasses (exposed by the corrected sample)
findings.fix: read enableZdpService, install_ssl_certs/installCerts first; split packetTunnelExcludeList; count bypassCustomAppIds

                     vals = [x.get("name") or x.get("url") or x.get("domain") or x.get("ip") or x.get("path") or json.dumps(x)[:80] if isinstance(x, dict) else str(x) for x in v]

findings.title: ZCC company-info check (zscaler_full_checks.zcc_5) reads companyName, which getCompanyInfo does not send (businessName), so it always says 'Company: ?'
findings.fix: read businessName first
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/zscaler_full_checks.py
+++ b/zscaler_full_checks.py
@@ -722,7 +722,8 @@
     """Company info"""
     d, c = cl.get("/zcc/companyInfo")
     if c in (200, 204) and isinstance(d, dict):
-        name = d.get("companyName", d.get("name", "?"))
+        # getCompanyInfo names the company businessName (zscaler/zcc/models/company_info.py).
+        name = d.get("businessName") or d.get("companyName") or d.get("name") or "?"
         return R(R.PASS, f"Company: {name}")
     return R(R.WARN, "Cannot retrieve company info. Note: This may indicate the ZCC API scope is not enabled for this API client. Verify API role includes ZCC read permissions.")

findings.title: _scope_selection and _beacon_scope drop a non-empty channel declaration whose entries cannot be read, so it narrows nothing instead of making every channel a gap (channel_scope.effective's rule)
findings.fix: keep any non-empty dict as the declaration

findings.title: Readiness reports a read-only role before a missing licence for a write kind that has a permission to check (web), while a kind without one (email) says not licensed
findings.fix: kept: tests/test_qa6_verdicts_reports.py encodes this precedence; the oracle in this area's tests records it

findings.title: readiness.ZIA_PERMS lists URL_FILTERING_CONTROL and CLOUD_APP_CONTROL, which SDK 1.11.3's admin_roles docs do not name
findings.fix: kept as aliases only (never the first spelling, so no step asks for them); test-enforced

findings.title: The sample answers no Client Connector endpoint the SDK does not document (appPostureInfo, webMachineTunnel, webZPNModuleMode, webBrowserProtectionProfile, getLastAppPostureFields), nor sandbox quota, ZTW or the CBI config paths
findings.fix: kept: their real answers are unverified, and the checks treat 404 as 'not in the public API'
